полный код графика
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 7))
labels = data["labels"]
values = data["values"]

# Merge small slices (<5%) into "Other"
total = sum(values)
threshold = 0.05 * total
ml, mv, other = [], [], 0
for l, v in zip(labels, values):
    if v >= threshold:
        ml.append(l)
        mv.append(v)
    else:
        other += v
if other > 0:
    ml.append("Other")
    mv.append(other)

# Plot the pie chart
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax.pie(
    mv, labels=ml, autopct="%1.1f%%", startangle=90,
    wedgeprops={"edgecolor": "white", "linewidth": 1.5},
)

# Style the autotexts
for at in autotexts:
    at.set_fontsize(9)

# Set the title if available
if data.get("title"):
    ax.set_title(data["title"], fontsize=14, pad=16)

# Ensure the pie is a circle
ax.axis("equal")

# Adjust layout
fig.tight_layout()
